items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: Oh, yeah. Those were your four saxophones.

ctx.x: Let's -- we said -- you couldn't -- you weren't so sure who were those seven pieces you had then. Let's think back. Did you say -- was Sam Taylor with you then?
No. Sam Taylor wasn't there. I think I told you who was there.
